title: Medicines That Change Your Rehab Plan — Six Patients, Six Surprises

hook.en: Behind every patient is a pill box that quietly changes how their body answers you. A heart rate that will not rise, a bruise that appears overnight, a tendon that gives way. Meet six patients who surprised their physios, and learn the one move that keeps each of them safe.
hook.ur: Har mareez ke peechay ek dawaiyon ka dibba hota hai jo khamoshi se tay karta hai ke un ka jism aap ko kya jawab dega. Dil ki raftar jo barhti nahi, raat bhar mein nikla neel, ek tendon jo toot gaya. Chhe mareezon se milein jinhon ne apne physios ko hairaan kiya, aur sikhein woh ek qadam jo har ek ko mehfooz rakhta hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll recognise the main medicine families that change rehabilitation, know the surprise each one can cause, ask the four detective questions, and know when to adapt, when to report and when to call for help. You will never start, stop or change a medicine yourself.
goal.ur: End tak aap rehab badalne wali bari dawaiyon ke khandan pehchanenge, har ek ka hairaan karne wala asar jaanenge, chaar detective sawal poochhenge, aur jaanenge ke kab tabdeeli, kab report aur kab madad bulani hai. Aap kabhi khud koi dawai shuru, band ya tabdeel nahi karenge.

text.en: **Why medicines matter to a physio.** You do not prescribe, but you see what medicines do in the gym, on the plinth and on the stairs. A medicine can change the heart rate, the blood pressure, the blood's ability to clot, the strength of a tendon, the sugar level and how awake the patient is. You are often the first person to notice a side effect, because you watch the patient move and sweat. Your job is the four verbs: **ask, adapt, report, and call for help**.
text.ur: **Physio ke liye dawaiyan kyun ahem hain.** Aap dawai likhte nahi, lekin aap dekhte hain ke dawaiyan gym, plinth aur seedhiyon par kya karti hain. Ek dawai dil ki raftar, blood pressure, khoon ke jamne ki salahiyat, tendon ki taqat, sugar ki satah aur mareez ki hoshiyari badal sakti hai. Aap aksar pehle shakhs hote hain jo side effect dekhte hain, kyunke aap mareez ko harkat karte aur paseena aate dekhte hain. Aap ka kaam chaar fail hain: **poochhna, dhalna, report karna, aur madad bulana**.

text.en: Think of the patient as a **car with a modified engine**. The engine may have a governor that stops it revving, a thinner oil that leaks sooner, or a brake that is always a little on. You cannot see the changes by looking, but they change how the car responds on the road. Medicines are the modifications; the questions you ask are the way you read the badge under the bonnet.
text.ur: Mareez ko **badle hue engine wali gaari** sochein. Engine mein governor ho sakta hai jo rev nahi barhne deta, patla oil jo jaldi leak ho, ya brake jo hamesha thodi lagi rahe. Dekhne se tabdeeliyan nazar nahi aatin, lekin sadak par gaari ka jawab badal dete hain. Dawaiyan tabdeeliyan hain; aap ke sawal bonnet ke neeche likha badge parhne ka tareeqa hain.

text.en: **Patient 1, Mr Rashid, 72: the bruise that appeared overnight.** After his second session of deep soft-tissue work, a large purple bruise spreads over his thigh. He takes a **blood thinner** for his heart rhythm. Blood thinners (anticoagulants such as warfarin or the newer tablets, and antiplatelets such as aspirin or clopidogrel) make bleeding easier and longer. **Your move:** ask about them at the first visit, avoid deep pressure, strong friction, cupping or thrust techniques, protect against falls, and send the patient the same day to a doctor after any knock to the head, sudden swelling of a limb or joint, nosebleeds that will not stop or black stools.
text.ur: **Mareez 1, Mr Rashid, 72: raat bhar mein nikla neel.** Gehre soft-tissue kaam ke doosre session ke baad un ki thigh par bada jamni neel phail jata hai. Woh dil ki rhythm ke liye **khoon patla karne wali dawai** leta hai. Khoon patla karne wali dawaiyan (anticoagulants jaise warfarin ya nayi goliyan, aur antiplatelets jaise aspirin ya clopidogrel) khoon ko aasani se aur der tak behne deti hain. **Aap ka qadam:** pehle visit par poochhein, gehra dabao, tez friction, cupping ya thrust techniques se bachein, girne se hifazat karein, aur sar par chot, kisi hissay ya joint ki achanak soojan, na ruknay wali naak ki khoon ya kaale pakhaane par usi din doctor ke paas bhejein.

text.en: **Patient 2, Mrs Fatima, 58: the heart rate that would not rise.** She walks briskly on the treadmill, breathing hard and sweating, but her heart rate stays at 85. Her therapist worries she is unfit. She takes a **beta-blocker** for blood pressure and a fast heart. Beta-blockers hold the heart rate down at rest and in exercise, so a target heart rate is meaningless for her. **Your move:** use the **rate of perceived exertion and the talk test** instead (hard but able to say a short sentence), and stop if she has chest pain, a pulse that is very slow with dizziness, or fainting.
text.ur: **Mareez 2, Mrs Fatima, 58: dil ki raftar jo barhti nahi.** Woh treadmill par tez chalti hai, saans phoolti hai aur paseena aata hai, lekin dil ki raftar 85 par rehti hai. Un ki therapist ko lagta hai woh unfit hain. Woh blood pressure aur tez dil ki dhadkan ke liye **beta-blocker** leti hain. Beta-blockers aaram aur exercise dono mein dil ki raftar neechay rakhte hain, isliye un ke liye target heart rate be-maani hai. **Aap ka qadam:** uski jagah **rate of perceived exertion aur talk test** istemal karein (mushkil lekin chhota jumla bol sake), aur seene ke dard, bohat dheemi nabz ke saath chakkar, ya behoshi par rok dein.

text.en: **Patient 3, Uncle Tariq, 64: the tendon that gave way.** He walks well in clinic after a course of a strong antibiotic for a chest infection, and then feels his Achilles snap on a stair. A few antibiotics (the **fluoroquinolones**, such as ciprofloxacin and levofloxacin) and **steroid injections** can weaken tendons, especially in people over 60 or those on steroids. **Your move:** ask about recent antibiotics and injections before you load tendons; after an injection follow the prescriber's rest advice before heavy loading; and stop and report new tendon pain, swelling or a snapping feeling instead of pushing through.
text.ur: **Mareez 3, Uncle Tariq, 64: tendon jo toot gaya.** Seene ki infection ke liye mazboot antibiotic ke course ke baad woh clinic mein theek chalte hain, aur phir seedhi par un ka Achilles snap kar jata hai. Kuch antibiotics (**fluoroquinolones**, jaise ciprofloxacin aur levofloxacin) aur **steroid injections** tendons ko kamzor kar sakte hain, khaaskar 60 se upar ya steroids lene walon mein. **Aap ka qadam:** tendons ko load karne se pehle haal ke antibiotics aur injections ke baare mein poochhein; injection ke baad bhari loading se pehle prescriber ki aaram ki hidayat par chalein; aur nayi tendon dard, soojan ya snap ke ehsaas par zor lagane ke bajaye rukein aur report karein.

text.en: **Patient 4, Uncle Aslam, 63: the weak legs.** Three months after starting a cholesterol medicine, he says his thighs feel heavy and sore, and he cannot climb stairs as before. **Statins** cause muscle aches or weakness in some people, and very rarely a serious muscle breakdown that can damage the kidneys. **Your move:** record when the symptoms began relative to the medicine and to new exercise, and report new unexplained muscle pain or weakness to the prescriber; if there is severe pain, fever or dark urine, the same-day review is needed. Never tell the patient to stop the medicine: that is the prescriber's decision.
text.ur: **Mareez 4, Uncle Aslam, 63: kamzor taangein.** Cholesterol ki dawai shuru karne ke teen mahine baad woh kehte hain ke un ki thighs bhaari aur dukhti hain, aur woh seedhiyan pehle ki tarah nahi chadh sakte. **Statins** kuch logon mein muscle dard ya kamzori karti hain, aur bohat kam, aise muscle ka toot jana jo gurdon ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai. **Aap ka qadam:** likhein ke symptoms dawai aur nayi exercise ke mukable mein kab shuru hue, aur nayi wajah ke baghair muscle dard ya kamzori prescriber ko report karein; shadeed dard, bukhaar ya gehre rang ke peshab par usi din review chahiye. Mareez ko dawai band karne ko kabhi na kahein: yeh prescriber ka faisla hai.

text.en: **Patient 5, Aunt Nasreen, 66: the shakes in the middle of the session.** Twenty minutes into balance exercises she turns pale, sweats, shakes and cannot find her words. She takes **insulin** and a tablet that pushes the pancreas to release insulin. Exercise uses sugar, and the sugar can fall during exercise or many hours afterwards. A **beta-blocker** can hide some of the warning signs. **Your move:** ask when she last ate and took her medicine, have fast sugar ready, stop at the first sign, and treat low sugar by your clinic protocol and call for help if she is not fully alert.
text.ur: **Mareez 5, Aunt Nasreen, 66: session ke beech mein kaanpna.** Balance exercises ke bees minute baad woh zard ho jati hain, paseena aata hai, kaanpti hain aur alfaaz nahi dhoondh paateen. Woh **insulin** aur aisi goli leti hain jo pancreas se insulin chhodwati hai. Exercise sugar istemal karti hai, aur sugar exercise ke dauran ya kai ghanton baad gir sakti hai. **Beta-blocker** kuch warning signs chhupa sakta hai. **Aap ka qadam:** poochhein ke aakhri khana aur dawai kab li, tez sugar tayyar rakhein, pehli alamat par rok dein, aur kam sugar ka ilaaj clinic protocol ke mutabiq karein aur agar poori tarah hoshiyar na ho to madad bulayein.

text.en: **Patient 6, Mr Hussain, 78: the dizzy stand-up and the drowsy morning.** Every time he stands from the plinth he sways and nearly falls, and he is sleepy before noon. He takes several **blood-pressure tablets, a water tablet, a sleeping tablet and a strong painkiller**. These drugs can drop his pressure on standing and slow his reactions. **Your move:** measure lying and standing pressure when the clinic protocol allows (a fall of 20 points in the top number or 10 in the bottom within three minutes is a drop that matters), teach him to rise slowly in stages, look at his alertness, and report new dizziness, falls or confusion.
text.ur: **Mareez 6, Mr Hussain, 78: chakkar wala uthna aur neend bhari subah.** Jab bhi woh plinth se uthte hain jhoomte hain aur girte girte bachte hain, aur dopahar se pehle ghoonte lagte hain. Woh kai **blood pressure ki goliyan, paani wali goli, neend ki goli aur tez dard ki dawai** lete hain. Yeh dawaiyan khade hone par pressure gira sakti hain aur reactions dheemay kar sakti hain. **Aap ka qadam:** clinic protocol ke mutabiq letay aur khade hokar pressure naapein (teen minute mein oopar wale number mein 20 ya neechay wale mein 10 ki kami ahem hai), unhein dheere dheere marhalon mein uthna sikhayein, hoshiyari dekhein, aur naya chakkar, girna ya uljhan report karein.

title.en: Nine medicine families, what you may see, what you do
title.ur: Nau dawaiyon ke khandan, aap kya dekh sakte hain, aur kya karna hai

rows.ur: Khoon patla karne wali

rows.en: Easy bruising, bleeding, swelling after pressure; bleeding after a fall
rows.ur: Aasani se neel, khoon behna, dabao ke baad soojan; girne ke baad khoon

rows.en: Avoid deep pressure and thrust; fall care; same-day review after head knock
rows.ur: Gehra dabao aur thrust nahi; girne se hifazat; sar par chot ke baad usi din review

rows.en: Beta-blockers
rows.ur: Beta-blockers

rows.en: Low heart rate that will not rise; tiredness; hidden signs of low sugar
rows.ur: Kam dil ki raftar jo barhti nahi; thakan; kam sugar ki chhupi alamatein

rows.en: Use effort scales and the talk test; stop with dizziness or chest pain
rows.ur: Effort scales aur talk test; chakkar ya seene ke dard par rokein

rows.en: Steroid injections and long-term steroids
rows.ur: Steroid injections aur lambay arsay ke steroids

rows.en: Weaker tendons, muscle weakness, thin bones, easy bruising
rows.ur: Kamzor tendons, muscle ki kamzori, patli haddiyan, aasani se neel

rows.en: Gentle progression, prescriber's rest advice, report tendon pain
rows.ur: Narm progression, prescriber ki aaram ki hidayat, tendon dard report

rows.en: Fluoroquinolone antibiotics
rows.ur: Fluoroquinolone antibiotics

rows.en: Tendon pain or rupture, especially the Achilles, in older people
rows.ur: Tendon dard ya phatna, khaaskar Achilles, buzurgon mein

rows.en: Ask about recent courses; stop loading and report new tendon pain
rows.ur: Haal ke courses poochhein; naye tendon dard par loading rokein aur report karein

rows.en: Statins
rows.ur: Statins

rows.en: Muscle ache, heaviness or weakness; rare dark urine
rows.ur: Muscle dard, bhaari pan ya kamzori; kam hi gehra peshab

rows.en: Note timing; report unexplained pain; urgent if severe or dark urine; never stop it yourself
rows.ur: Waqt likhein; be-wajah dard report; shadeed ya gehre peshab par urgent; khud kabhi band na karein

rows.en: Insulin and sugar-lowering tablets
rows.ur: Insulin aur sugar kam karne wali goliyan

rows.en: Sweating, shaking, hunger, confusion, headache during or hours after exercise
rows.ur: Exercise ke dauran ya kai ghanton baad paseena, kaanpna, bhook, uljhan, sar dard

rows.en: Ask about meals and timing; keep fast sugar ready; treat by protocol
rows.ur: Khane aur waqt ke baare mein poochhein; tez sugar tayyar; protocol ke mutabiq ilaaj

rows.en: Blood-pressure tablets and water tablets
rows.ur: Blood pressure ki goliyan aur paani wali goliyan

rows.en: Dizzy on standing, tiredness, cramps, falls
rows.ur: Khade hone par chakkar, thakan, cramps, girna

rows.en: Lying and standing pressure; rise slowly; hydration advice by the doctor
rows.ur: Letay aur khade pressure; dheere uthein; paani ki salah doctor se

rows.en: Strong painkillers, sleeping tablets and nerve-pain tablets
rows.ur: Tez dard ki dawaiyan, neend ki goliyan aur nerve dard ki goliyan

rows.en: Drowsiness, slower reactions, unsteadiness, confusion, falls

rows.en: Check alertness; fall precautions; report new sleepiness or confusion
rows.ur: Hoshiyari dekhein; girne se hifazat; nayi neend ya uljhan report

rows.ur: Soojan kam karne wali dard ki goliyan (NSAIDs)

rows.ur: Sirf dard nahi, load ko tolein; kaale pakhaane report; dose ka tareeqa poochhein

title.en: Four detective questions for every new patient
title.ur: Har naye mareez ke liye chaar detective sawal

steps.title: What do you take?
steps.detail: Ask for the actual boxes or a photo of the list. Include injections, creams, herbal and street-bought remedies, and supplements. || Aap kya lete hain?

steps.title: What is it for?
steps.detail: The reason tells you what the body is dealing with: heart rhythm, pressure, sugar, pain, infection. || Yeh kis liye hai?

steps.title: What changed recently?
steps.detail: A new tablet, a stopped tablet or a changed dose is when problems appear. || Haal mein kya badla?

steps.title: Any new symptoms since?
steps.detail: Dizziness, bruising, muscle pain, sleepiness, black stools, palpitations. Write down the date they started. || Tab se koi nayi alamat?

question.en: A patient on a beta-blocker asks, "My heart rate never goes above 90 even when I am out of breath. Am I unfit?" What is the best response?
question.ur: Beta-blocker lene wala mareez poochhta hai, "Meri dil ki raftar 90 se oopar nahi jati chahe saans phool jaye. Kya main unfit hoon?" Behtareen jawab kya hai?

text.en: Tell him to ask his doctor to stop the tablet so his heart rate rises
text.ur: Usay kahein ke doctor se goli band karwaye taake dil ki raftar barhe

feedback.en: You never advise stopping a medicine, and he may need it.
feedback.ur: Aap dawai band karne ki salah kabhi nahi dete, aur usay ise ki zaroorat ho sakti hai.

text.en: Push him until his heart rate reaches the usual target
text.ur: Usay tab tak dhakelein jab tak dil ki raftar aam target tak pohnche

feedback.en: That would mean working dangerously hard.
feedback.ur: Is ka matlab khatarnak had tak mehnat karwana hoga.

text.en: Explain the medicine holds the heart rate down, and use effort scales and the talk test to guide intensity
text.ur: Samjhayein ke dawai dil ki raftar roke hui hai, aur intensity ke liye effort scales aur talk test istemal karein

feedback.en: Yes — the heart rate is not a reliable guide on a beta-blocker; effort is.
feedback.ur: Haan — beta-blocker par dil ki raftar bharosemand rehnuma nahi; effort hai.

question.en: A 70-year-old on a blood thinner knocks her head on a cupboard in the clinic. She says she feels fine. What is the safest action?
question.ur: Khoon patla karne wali dawai par 70 saal ki khatoon clinic mein almari se sar tarati hain. Woh kehti hain theek hoon. Sab se mehfooz qadam kya hai?

text.en: Arrange a same-day medical assessment even though she feels fine
text.ur: Chahe woh theek mehsoos kare, usi din medical assessment karwayein

feedback.en: Yes — bleeding inside the head can be delayed, and blood thinners raise the risk.
feedback.ur: Haan — sar ke andar khoon rukna der se ho sakta hai, aur khoon patla karne wali dawaiyan khatra barhati hain.

text.en: Give her a painkiller and continue the session
text.ur: Dard ki goli dein aur session jaari rakhein

feedback.en: You do not give medicines, and a head knock on a blood thinner needs a doctor.
feedback.ur: Aap dawai nahi dete, aur khoon patla karne walay ka sar par chot doctor se dikhana lazmi hai.

text.en: Let her go home and review her tomorrow
text.ur: Ghar jane dein aur kal review

feedback.en: Delay can be dangerous with a head injury on a blood thinner.
feedback.ur: Sar ki chot par khoon patla karne wali dawai ke saath der khatarnak ho sakti hai.

question.en: A patient on insulin becomes pale, sweaty and shaky 20 minutes into the session but is still awake. What do you do first?
question.ur: Insulin lene wala mareez session ke bees minute baad zard, paseenay mein aur kaanpta hai lekin jaag raha hai. Aap pehle kya karein?

text.en: Tell him to take extra insulin
text.ur: Usay mazeed insulin lene ko kahein

feedback.en: That would drop sugar further and is dangerous.
feedback.ur: Isse sugar aur gir jayegi aur yeh khatarnak hai.

text.en: Encourage him to finish the set and drink water
text.ur: Set poora karne ko kahein aur paani dein

feedback.en: Exercise uses more sugar and makes a low worse.
feedback.ur: Exercise mazeed sugar istemal karti hai aur kami ko bigarti hai.

text.en: Stop exercise, sit him down and treat suspected low sugar by your clinic protocol, calling for help if he worsens
text.ur: Exercise rokein, bithayein aur mumkin kam sugar ka ilaaj clinic protocol ke mutabiq karein, bigre to madad bulayein

feedback.en: Yes — these signs fit low blood sugar, and early treatment prevents a worse episode.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh alamatein kam sugar se milti hain, aur jaldi ilaaj bigarne se bachata hai.

text.en: **Playing doctor.** The patient says, "My knees ache since the cholesterol tablet. Should I stop it?" The kind answer is not "yes" and not "no". Stopping a statin, a blood thinner or a beta-blocker suddenly can be dangerous in itself. Write down the details, explain that the prescriber needs to know, and help the patient contact them today.
text.ur: **Doctor ban jana.** Mareez kehta hai, "Cholesterol ki goli ke baad ghutne dukhte hain. Kya band kar dun?" Meharbaan jawab na "haan" hai na "nahi". Statin, khoon patla karne wali ya beta-blocker achanak band karna khud khatarnak ho sakta hai. Tafseel likhein, samjhayein ke prescriber ko pata hona chahiye, aur aaj hi unse rabta karne mein madad karein.

text.en: **Ask in a way that gets honest answers.** Use open, respectful questions: "Which tablets, injections, herbal drinks or home remedies do you take to stay well?" Many patients forget herbal and shop-bought remedies, and some of those change bleeding or blood pressure. Ask them to bring all packets to the next visit, and say that you ask so that you can keep them safe, not to judge.
text.ur: **Aise poochhein ke sachchay jawab milein.** Khule, izzat bhare sawal poochhein: "Aap tandurusti ke liye kaun si goliyan, injections, desi jari-bootiyan ya gharelu nuskhe lete hain?" Bohat se mareez desi aur dukaan se li hui cheezein bhool jate hain, aur kuch khoon behne ya blood pressure ko badal deti hain. Unhein agle visit par saare packets lane ko kahein, aur batayein ke aap isliye poochhte hain ke unhein mehfooz rakh sakein, parakhne ke liye nahi.

question.en: Why can a medicine make a "normal" exercise session unsafe even when the patient looks well at the start?
question.ur: Dawai "aam" exercise session ko ghair mehfooz kyun bana sakti hai jabke mareez shuru mein theek lagta hai?

answer.en: Because many medicines change the body's safety margins, not the starting picture. A blood thinner leaves the patient well until a bleed starts; insulin leaves the patient well until the sugar falls; a beta-blocker hides the usual warning of effort. The danger appears only when the body is pushed, which is exactly what rehabilitation does.
answer.ur: Kyunke bohat si dawaiyan jism ke safety margins badalti hain, shuru ki tasveer nahi. Khoon patla karne wali dawai mareez ko tab tak theek rakhti hai jab tak khoon behna shuru na ho; insulin tab tak theek rakhti hai jab tak sugar gir na jaye; beta-blocker effort ki aam warning chhupa deta hai. Khatra tab hi nazar aata hai jab jism ko dhakela jaye, aur rehab bilkul yahi karti hai.

text.en: **You never start, stop or change a medicine, and you do not diagnose a side effect.** Notice, ask, adapt the session and report to the prescriber. Call emergency services for a head knock on a blood thinner with headache, vomiting or drowsiness, black or bloody stools, chest pain, fainting, severe weakness with dark urine, or low sugar in a patient who is not fully awake.
text.ur: **Aap kabhi dawai shuru, band ya tabdeel nahi karte, aur side effect ka diagnosis nahi karte.** Dekhein, poochhein, session dhalein aur prescriber ko report karein. Khoon patla karne wali dawai par sar ki chot ke saath dard-e-sar, ulti ya neend, kaale ya khooni pakhaane, seene ka dard, behoshi, gehre peshab ke saath shadeed kamzori, ya aise mareez mein kam sugar jo poori tarah hoshiyar na ho to emergency bulayein.

text.en: The American College of Sports Medicine position stand on exercise and hypertension notes that beta-blockers lower heart rate during exercise, so intensity should be guided by perceived exertion. Tendon rupture with fluoroquinolone antibiotics led to a boxed warning from the US Food and Drug Administration, with higher risk in older people and people taking steroids. A review of statin side effects found muscle symptoms are a recognised reason people stop statins, while severe muscle damage is rare and needs urgent assessment.
text.ur: American College of Sports Medicine ke exercise aur hypertension position stand ke mutabiq beta-blockers exercise mein dil ki raftar kam karte hain, isliye intensity ko mehsoos hone wali mehnat se rehnuma banana chahiye. Fluoroquinolone antibiotics ke saath tendon phatne par US Food and Drug Administration ne boxed warning di, jis mein buzurgon aur steroids lene walon mein khatra zyada hai. Statin side effects ke review ne dikhaya ke muscle ki alamatein statin chhodne ki maaroof wajah hain, jabke shadeed muscle nuqsan kam hai aur urgent assessment chahta hai.

text.en: **ASK, ADAPT, REPORT, CALL.** Ask what they take, adapt the session to what the medicine does, report what you see to the prescriber, and call for help in the danger signs.
text.ur: **ASK, ADAPT, REPORT, CALL.** Poochhein kya lete hain, session ko dawai ke asar ke mutabiq dhalein, jo dekhein prescriber ko report karein, aur khatray ki alamaton mein madad bulayein.

summary.en: Medicines change the heart rate, bleeding, tendon strength, sugar and alertness, so ask about them before you load, press or push.
summary.ur: Dawaiyan dil ki raftar, khoon behna, tendon ki taqat, sugar aur hoshiyari badalti hain, isliye load, dabao ya zor se pehle poochhein.

summary.en: Use effort scales on beta-blockers, avoid deep pressure on blood thinners, and watch tendons after antibiotics or injections.
summary.ur: Beta-blockers par effort scales, khoon patla karne walon par gehra dabao nahi, aur antibiotics ya injections ke baad tendons par nazar.

summary.en: Never advise stopping a medicine; report your findings, and call for help for the danger signs.
summary.ur: Dawai band karne ki salah kabhi na dein; jo dekha report karein, aur khatray ki alamaton par madad bulayein.

front.en: What can a beta-blocker do to exercise heart rate?
front.ur: Beta-blocker exercise mein dil ki raftar ke saath kya karta hai?

back.en: It holds it down, so use effort scales and the talk test.
back.ur: Isay neechay rakhta hai, isliye effort scales aur talk test.

front.en: What should you avoid with a patient on a blood thinner?
front.ur: Khoon patla karne wali dawai par mareez ke saath kya na karein?

back.en: Deep pressure, strong friction and thrust techniques.
back.ur: Gehra dabao, tez friction aur thrust techniques.

front.en: Which antibiotic family can weaken tendons?
front.ur: Kaun sa antibiotic khandan tendons ko kamzor kar sakta hai?

front.en: What are the four detective questions?
front.ur: Chaar detective sawal kaun se hain?

back.en: What do you take, what is it for, what changed, any new symptoms?
back.ur: Kya lete hain, kis liye, kya badla, koi nayi alamat?

goDeeper.title: Exercise stop signs and ward mobilisation

note.en: The stop signs that apply to every patient.
note.ur: Woh stop signs jo har mareez par lagu hain.
